overview_description.description: Mars Auto is developing autonomous trucks to completely automate warehouse to warehouse truck operations.The startup is developing autonomous trucks for the $50 billion Korean trucking market. The goal is to fully automate warehouse to warehouse truck operations to save the trucking market billions. The company has two LOIs with two of the largest logistic businesses in Korea.

product.description: Software designed specifically for autonomous driving in trucks, enabling them to operate without human intervention.

product.name: Sensor Configuration
product.description: Custom sensor setups for trucks to ensure safe stopping and operation under various conditions.

product.name: Actuator Design
product.description: Design of mechanical systems like accelerators, actuators, and brakes tailored for autonomous trucks.

product.name: Fleet Management System
product.description: A system for managing and analyzing autonomous driving data and operations.

product.name: Data-Driven Approach
product.description: A method that uses collected data to improve the autonomous driving model continuously.

product.name: Autonomous Freight Shipping
product.description: Service for transporting goods using self-driving trucks.
